testcase.name: Scenario: Use large ribbon commands and restore normal appearance: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-appearance-source/features/application/ribbon-appearance/ribbon-appearance.feature:46:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Use large ribbon commands and restore normal appearance ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon uses the Compact appearance ✔ When the user selects "Large" from the Ribbon Appearance submenu ✔ Then larger command icons appear in two rows without visible command labels ✔ And panel titles remain visible ✔ When the user reopens the Ribbon Appearance submenu ✔ Then "Large" is marked as selected ✔ When the user selects "Normal" ✔ Then the ribbon shows its mixed-size icons and command labels again ✔ And the part remains visible
